test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A person sold a pen drive for Rs. 1,674 and incurred a loss of 7 %. At what price (in Rs.) should it be sold to earn a profit of 11%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of the pen drive = Rs. 1674

Loss % = 7

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price + cost price × profit%

Selling price = Cost price - cost price × loss%

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the pen drive be 100a

According to the question,

100a - 100a × 7% = 1674

⇒ 93a = 1674

⇒ a = 1674/93

⇒ a = 18

So, cost price = 100 × 18

⇒ Rs. 1800

Now,

Selling price to get a profit of 11% = 1800 + 1800 × 11%

⇒ 1998

**∴ It should be sold at 1998 (in Rs.) to earn a profit of 11%.**
